name: Context Mode
summary: A sandboxed MCP server whose tools fetch and filter bulky data before it reaches the context, plus hooks on six events. Held: native output caps (Claude Code 2.1.261) and large MCP results saved to a file cover most cases. It keeps its own snapshot at compaction and adds a SessionStart hook to user settings that uninstalling leaves behind.

evidence.effect: bashOutputMaxChars and taskOutputMaxChars keep up to 128K of output inline before it is saved to a file

evidence.setting: v7 review; not re-checked for v8
evidence.effect: Hooks six events, keeps its own snapshot at compaction, and adds a SessionStart hook to user settings each time its server starts; uninstalling leaves that hook

revisit: a user's dominant MCP server isn't covered by native caps
maintenance: Third-party project; last release v1.0.169 on 2026-06-29.
